sourceIdentity: Current dirty worktree; raw Nuxt output is Developer Build State and is not Product Runtime Image.

scanner.method: Recursive regular-file walk. UTF-8 text assets are decoded and counted; non-UTF-8 assets are checked without rewriting. Each matcher counts its own non-overlapping occurrences; absolutePathOccurrences uses the canonical repo-root-forward needle once per occurrence, while per-spelling counts are coverage diagnostics and MUST NOT be summed.
scanner.binaryAssetPolicy: Non-UTF-8 regular files are scanned as bytes and never rewritten; current Product public contains one .ttf and it has no forbidden marker.

absolutePathPatterns.description: file:// followed directly by Windows drive

absoluteNodeModuleFileUrlPattern.description: absolute Windows/POSIX file:// URL whose path reaches node_modules
absoluteNodeModuleFileUrlPattern.counting: count each regex occurrence; do not add to canonical repo-root occurrence totals

rawDeveloperBuild.reason: Raw entry and chunks retain file:// checkout node_modules imports; this failure is recorded and excluded from the Product Runtime Image gate.

productRuntimeImage.source: worktree/.output produced by bun run --cwd packages/neuro-book nuxt:build after Product public asset normalization

routeChunks.note: Final Product bundle prunes raw route chunks into server/index.mjs; HTTP probe is the formal route proof.

routeHttpProbe.target: isolated copy of rebuilt worktree/.output under system Temp
